assumptionPolicy: Project-wide corrections from implementation review override conflicting older exemplars; otherwise treat recorded rules as author intent until contradicted by nearer evidence.
priority: project-wide corrections: prefab-first, instance-scoped MVP, short comments, no magic numbers, error/logging policy

rules.instruction: Put mutable state, calculation and game rules in a constructor-injected non-MonoBehaviour Model.
Put Inspector references and Unity API mutations in a MonoBehaviour View.
Connect Model and View in a constructor-injected Presenter; use IStartable and ITickable for VContainer lifecycle.
Register Views with RegisterComponent, status assets with RegisterInstance, Models with Register<T>, and Presenters with RegisterEntryPoint.
Each independently spawned gameplay object or interactive UI instance owns independent Model and Presenter state/lifetime; class definitions may be shared but mutable runtime instances are not.
Keep GameLoop* limited to game-wide phase/orchestration; move per-instance movement, state, collision, input reaction and UI behavior into the instance MVP.
Runtime gameplay objects and interactive UI use Prefabs under the existing Assets/!MyAssets/Object/Prefab grouping; do not script-build or runtime-repair concerns that can be authored in Prefab.

patterns.name: status_boundary
patterns.shape: ScriptableObject *StatusInfo implements I*Status; Model depends on interface

patterns.name: runtime_status
patterns.shape: Pure C# *RuntimeInitializeStatus implements the same status interface for runtime relocation/reset

patterns.name: mutable_data_snapshot
patterns.shape: *Data stores mutable Model state; *DataPack exposes a get-only snapshot returned by GetDataPack()

patterns.name: math_boundary
patterns.shape: System.Numerics.Vector2 in calculation layers; UnityEngine.Vector2/Vector3 in Views

patterns.name: reactive_notification
patterns.shape: private readonly Subject<T>, public Observable<T>, CompositeDisposable ownership

patterns.name: instance_numeric_info
patterns.shape: Gameplay/UI numeric values come from the runtime instance *Info or the existing *StatusInfo serving that role; behavior code contains no magic numbers.

rules: Accept CancellationToken on public asynchronous boundaries.
Link caller token with GetCancellationTokenOnDestroy in MonoBehaviour Views.
Treat expected OperationCanceledException as normal completion with a cancellation filter.
Restore temporary runtime state in finally.
Kill and link DOTween tweens to their GameObject lifetime.

formatting.numericLiteralPolicy: No magic numbers in production behavior code; instance-specific numeric values come from *Info / existing *StatusInfo.

comments.length: approximately 1-15 characters for normal method/variable comments
comments.xmlSummaryUse: Preserve existing summaries when unrelated; do not add long summaries mechanically to new/changed code.
avoid: routine comments longer than 15 characters when naming/responsibility can be improved

testing.testDoubles: private sealed nested Stub implementing the production interface

doNotIntroduce: a second architecture beside existing MVP
new global singleton or Manager without an existing local precedent
Coroutine where nearby code uses UniTask
C# events where nearby code uses R3
bulk rename of serialized fields, PlayerPrefs keys, enum members or compatibility typos
new namespace in Assets/!lumirr/scripts without a project-wide decision
runtime gameplay/UI GameObject construction without a Prefab source
magic numbers in production behavior code

rules: Inspect and follow existing folder grouping/naming before adding Prefabs.
Do not use new GameObject, runtime AddComponent, or script-built UI when Prefab authoring can express the result.
Do not repair Prefab-authorable hierarchy, layout, visual, component or serialized-reference concerns in runtime code.

errorHandling.model: For expected errors use return, false, no-op, or existing Try-style result; do not depend on Unity logging.
errorHandling.unityDependent: Use Debug.Log when logging is needed, and wrap every production call in #if UNITY_EDITOR / #endif.
